label: late original-phase steps (t>=6) in sequences starting with digit 2
explanation: Fires only on the last few original-phase input steps (t=5-9, mostly to_go 0-2, so L=8-9 sequences dominate) and weakly on <DEL> (7% of mass); never fires during copy. About 70% of mass comes from sequences whose first token is 2 (lift 19x), with weaker contributions from sequences starting with l or w. Within those, the strongest activations land on inputs h, m, d and after prev token e, and activation rises with the number of digits in the sequence, but none of these conditions sharpens the predicate. Precision is low (~16%): most late steps in 2-initial sequences stay silent, so the trigger is a sparse conjunction this description does not capture. Best predicate on dev: F1 0.24, mass recall 0.59.
